summary: Uncommitted change turns parse() from Option into Result with typed, line-numbered errors, plus five tests.

defects.description: All three error tests assert only `is_err()`, so neither the error variant nor the line number is checked. Swapping variants or breaking `line_no` (e.g. `i + 1` -> `i * 1`, visible on the duplicate key at line 2) passes. Tests should assert_eq! the exact ParseError, including a line number > 1 and the duplicate key name.

The success tests assert only `is_ok()` / `len() == 1`; no parsed key or value is ever compared. Dropping the `.trim()` on keys or values, or swapping key and value on insert, passes. A test should compare the whole map (e.g. assert_eq! against a BTreeMap with host=example.com, port=8080).
